name: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 (non-W)

module.name: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 board
module.variant: Pico 2 without wireless or pre-soldered headers

record_note: The non-wireless Pico 2 has 4 MiB QSPI flash mapped through RP2350 XIP at 0x10000000 and a 12 MHz crystal. GPIO23, GPIO24, GPIO25, and GPIO29 are used by the on-board SMPS, USB sensing, user LED, and VSYS measurement. Architecture selection, boot security, linker layout, board revision, and USB/SWD flash profiles remain open.

qspi_xip_flash.notes: RP2350 XIP window begins at 0x10000000. Board flash capacity is 4 MiB; reserve boot metadata and SDK/application partitions in the eventual linker profile.
